decision.recommended_product_direction: Recover substantially the GVA layout, information hierarchy and exploratory flow on top of the national runtime, without rolling back its architecture or merging sources.

user_tasks.task: See the fires for one year
user_tasks.reason: GVA offers histogram selection and sliders; national requires entering the year twice and applying it.
GVA shows source-separated metrics; national exposes manifest, loaded and viewport values in technical summaries.
GVA shows explicitly typed totals by source; national mainly exposes known EGIF forest area below Spain scope.
GVA has area filtering, GIF and highlighted results; national has no equivalent product flow.
GVA filters and displays causes; national does not expose cause exploration and omitted an available ICV cause in the observed detail.
GVA has an interactive multi-source histogram; national has a long EGIF text distribution only where INITIAL is loaded.

user_tasks.task: Select a fire and understand its detail
user_tasks.reason: National selection is robust but puts technical identity before date, place, area and cause.
The EGIF value exists but is not an exploratory filter.
National adds official Spain to CCAA to province to municipality navigation, bounds, breadcrumb and serialized state.
GVA combines sliders and histogram; national uses numeric inputs and an Apply button.

user_tasks.task: Understand what is shown on the map
user_tasks.reason: GVA has a labelled basemap and visible legend; national lacks equivalent immediate cartographic context.

user_tasks.task: Know where the data comes from
user_tasks.reason: National provenance is more rigorous, but occupies too much primary attention.
National serializes more state and accepts legacy links, but the action is less prominent.

gva.map: Dominant labelled basemap with visible legend
gva.assessment: Human questions are visible before technical detail.

national.map: Unlabelled neutral background with national geometries and no equivalent public legend
national.assessment: Runtime control and diagnostics displace the human overview.

national_spain_1985_2021.warning: Viewport features are not a territorial total.

gva_strengths: Immediate historical overview and understandable map
Minimum area, cause and GIF filters
Source-separated metrics with immediate filter feedback
Prominent sharing and mostly public language
national_strengths: Official Spain to CCAA to province to municipality navigation
Rigorous separation of records, geometries, identities and sources
Complete serialized state, restore and legacy v1 compatibility
Cancellation, cache, isolated errors and provenance
Correct treatment of partial data and territories outside source coverage

product_regressions.description: No human overview of counts, typed areas and large fires.
Histogram, minimum area, GIF and cause exploration are absent.
The national map lacks the basemap, place names and clear public legend of GVA.
The detail card prioritizes IDs and geometry semantics and can omit useful available information.
Dataset and runtime states dominate the first screen.
On 390 by 844 the initial form occupies nearly the entire viewport before the map.
Period changes are less direct and lack visual historical context.
The annual EGIF distribution is difficult to scan as long text.
Features visible in viewport competes with meaningful territorial counts.
The product retains a form and debug prototype appearance.

language_policy.rule: Use familiar public wording together with a precise type and source; never imply a merged cross-source episode.

conceptual_wireframe: HEADER: atlas title, territory, period, Share
MAIN: labelled map, administrative boundary and legend beside a compact human summary
TIMELINE: source-separated histogram controlling year or range
FILTERS: applicable area, large-fire and documented-cause controls
RESULTS: short highlighted or relevant list
DETAIL: human-first card for the selected independent element
e2_scope: Public information model and vocabulary for primary, secondary and advanced levels
Semantic contract for every card and count without cross-source totals
Per-source and per-context area, GIF and cause filter contracts
Visually unified human card without creating a fused entity
Desktop and mobile layout plus territorial navigation
Recommended default view and advanced source controls
Public wording for coverage, loading and errors
Acceptance criteria traceable to available, partial and blocked data
